description: This file provides an abstraction layer for note storage, supporting both localStorage and Supabase backends, with fallback and error handling mechanisms.

classes.name: ErrorProvider
classes.description: Creates a provider that throws errors for all operations, used as fallback when backend initialization fails.

methods.name: uuid
methods.description: Generates a simple UUID v4-like string for local note IDs.

methods.name: hasLocalStorage
methods.description: Checks if localStorage is available and accessible.

methods.name: safeParse
methods.description: Safely parses JSON strings, returning a fallback on error.

methods.name: getStorageProvider
methods.description: Returns either a Supabase or localStorage storage provider based on environment variables.

methods.name: LocalStorageStorage
methods.description: Provides storage operations using browser's localStorage.

methods.name: SupabaseStorage
methods.description: Provides storage operations using Supabase backend, with lazy import to avoid bundling if unused.
